messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SEV2 — elevated 5xx and timeouts observed from control plane deps (authz, org-lookup, billing) -> spike starting ~4870012000. Major gateway 502/504s across eu-west and us-central. Paging oncall (Priya).
Maya: seeing the same in dashboards — authz latency jumped from 30ms -> 2.1s and error rate to 9%. KV cache hit rate dropped.
Jon: logs show org-lookup upstream returning 504s and repeated retries. stack: org-lookup -> redis/primary timed out -> fallback path failing.
Priya: @Maya @Jon I'm on it. Can someone dump the last 5m of gateway logs for 502 trace ids?
Maya: attaching quick grep (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z gateway error id=tx-9f3a code=502 upstream=org-lookup timeout_ms=1500
2026-03-15T10:12:35Z gateway error id=tx-9f3b code=504 upstream=authz timeout_ms=2000
```
Jon: I can repro locally hitting authz with heavy fanout; looks like connection pool exhaustion on authz pods. Heap/conn stats: conn_used 98/100, errors mismatch on new token refresh path.
Sam: support queue: ~12 tickets complaining about failed API calls, login errors for a handful of enterprise customers. CS flagged two on high SLA.
Luca: quick mitigation idea: enable authz short-circuit cache for validated tokens (30s) at gateway layer and reduce org-lookup fanout to single-read path. Can toggle via feature-flag.
Priya: go for the feature-flag toggle, Maya can you apply? Also increase gateway upstream timeout to 4s for authz and org-lookup while we triage so we avoid cascading 502s.
Maya: toggling ff now: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/flags/cache_shortcircuit -d '{"on":true}'` -> response 200.
OpsBot: FLAG CHANGE: cache_shortcircuit enabled by Maya at 4870012401 :memo:
Maya: increasing timeouts in gateway config and reloading: `kubectl apply -f gateway-timeout-patch.yaml` -> rolling reload started (pods ~50% updated).
Jon: traffic looks calmer — 5xx rate dropped from 9% -> ~3.5% within 60s of changes. Org-lookup still 200-500ms but errors reduced.
Priya: good. We should also scale org-lookup read replicas by +2 to relieve primary. Luca can you bump HPA min to take effect?
Luca: bumping now: `kubectl scale deployment/org-lookup --replicas=5` -> scaling initiated.
Ava: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated API errors; mitigation in progress; we will follow up with timeline." Any add-ins?
Sam: include that login attempts might intermittently fail and that retries are safe. Suggest using exponential backoff — customers already on SDKs will be fine.
Jon: digging deeper — authz token refresh path hits billing service for quota checks; billing service latency spiked due to DB retransmits. We should open a ticket with infra for DB IO anomaly.
Maya: opening infra ticket: INFRA-7543 DB IO flapping on billing-primary, linking this thread.
incident-bot: TICKET CREATED: INFRA-7543 linked to thread 4870012345
Priya: plan summary: (1) short-circuit token cache enabled, (2) gateway timeouts increased, (3) org-lookup scaled and HPA bumped, (4) infra ticket for billing DB IO. Monitoring for 20m then reassess. Anyone own postmortem?
Jon: I'll take the postmortem. I'll capture timeline, root cause hypotheses (DB IO -> billing slow -> authz fanout -> org-lookup cascade), and mitigation steps.
Maya: hands-off to next oncall in 30m — Priya you good to continue?
Priya: yes I will run the oncall through the handover at 4870012900. @Ava please hold the customer note until we confirm stabilization for 15m.
Ava: ack, will hold. Draft saved in #incidents-drafts.
OpsBot: NOTE: Service impact estimate: intermittent 5xx for ~8-12% of requests during peak window. Affected regions: eu-west, us-central. No data loss reported.
Sam: CS escalation: two enterprise customers want an ETA, advising "under active mitigation, next update in 20m".
Jon: watching error dashboards — tail latency for authz down to ~220ms, 5xx at ~1.2% now. Looks stable for 5m.
Priya: preparing handoff notes: current mitigations active, infra engaged, postmortem owner Jon, next update +20m. Handoff to oncall rotation: @Maya -> @Priya -> @Luca.
Maya: handing off pager to Priya at 4870012900. Good work team. :thumbsup:
Priya: taking over. If things recur, escalate to SEV1 and notify execs.
Jon: adding final checklist to the incident doc: revert short-circuit cache after 2h, confirm billing DB IO fixed, scale HPA to normal, validate no regression in token freshness.
Ava: prepping final customer note once confirmed stable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, monitoring. End of thread at 4870012950.
